spec_match.rationale: Creates real AudioContexts with the renderSizeHint option and reads back renderQuantumSize/sampleRate/baseLatency — the exact v145 surfaces.

interactive.rationale: Start/stop oscillator at each quantum works; CDP trusted click populated the full stats readout (renderQuantumSize 128, 44100 Hz, 2.90 ms quantum, baseLatency 10 ms).

edge_cases.rationale: The pre-145 fallback (constructor throw → plain AudioContext) exists, but on pre-145 engines the page silently reports the default 128 rather than explicitly labelling that the hint was ignored.

references.rationale: chromestatus link added to see-also (was missing — invariant 3).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Mobile 360x740 DPR3 scrollWidth now 360 (was 373 — 13px clip); stats grid columns now shrinkable; desktop CDP interaction verified with screenshot; console clean except environmental fonts request.

telemetry_health.rationale: No page asserts distinguishing hint-honoured vs hint-ignored.

accessibility.rationale: Controls are labelled native elements, but the stats readout is not a live region, so quantum changes are visual-only for SR users.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 13px clip fixed via minmax grid columns + overflow-wrap; both classes screenshot-verified.

openQuestions.title: Label the hint-ignored state explicitly
openQuestions.detail: When renderSizeHint is requested but ctx.renderQuantumSize comes back 128 on a pre-145 engine (as it does in this Chromium 141 run), the readout should say 'hint not honoured on this engine' instead of presenting 128 as the requested result; add a telemetry assert for the honoured case.

openQuestions.title: Make the stats readout a polite live region
openQuestions.detail: aria-live=polite on the stats stage (or a summary line) would surface quantum changes non-visually.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table horizontal scroll container mobile overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide content scrolls in its own overflow:auto container; min-width:0 / overflow-wrap on flex-grid items with long unbreakable strings; flex-wrap where overflow is possible.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped wide tables/readouts in dedicated overflow-x:auto containers (tabindex=0, labelled region) or added min-width:0 + overflow-wrap:anywhere to grid/flex value cells; page scrollWidth measured 360 at 360px viewport after the fix.

summary: Added the missing chromestatus reference link (invariant 3) and fixed the 13px mobile clip by making the stats grid columns shrinkable (minmax + overflow-wrap). Interaction re-verified: real AudioContext with renderSizeHint, stats populate on start. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via raw CDP (trusted Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile + 1280x800 desktop emulation, screenshots read) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so 145-only success paths were validated on their honest fallback branches. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental and not counted against the page.
